purpose: Frozen direct-confirmation questionnaire for candidate facilities. Requirements must not be weakened after responses are received.
evidence_rule: YES or CONDITIONAL requires dated supporting evidence or a named accountable facility contact. UNKNOWN remains unresolved; silence is never converted to NO or YES.

global_questions.question: Can the facility return raw or minimally processed machine-readable data for every requested acquisition, with raw and processed files separated?
Can the facility preserve immutable source files and provide SHA-256 hashes plus a manifest for returned evidence?
Can excluded or invalid rows remain in the returned data with explicit QC/exclusion reason codes rather than being silently removed?

Can the exact instrument/source/detector/software configuration identifiers remain frozen across prerequisite and decision-driving measurements, or can every change be explicitly bridged and documented?
Can the facility preserve the hierarchy lot -> substrate -> device/pixel -> session -> sweep or step replicate -> measurement in its exports?
Can the facility execute the frozen acquisition order and prospective holdout without using holdout observations to tune the analysis/model/QC criteria?
Can the facility provide applicable uncertainty/provenance documentation for calibration, responsivity, timing, and linearity terms rather than treating unreported terms as zero?
Can all requested work be performed within the facility's optical, electrical, thermal, source-duty, interlock, sample-acceptance, shipping, and EHS constraints without bypassing safety limits?

questions.question: Can you provide a calibrated broadband reference detector applicable to the intended R2 source/geometry/range?
Will the calibration certificate/report and applicability/version metadata be returned with the dataset?
Can wavelength-resolved source spectra be acquired at every frozen R2 intensity point from 0.05 to 2 suns under the same source/attenuation geometry used for Voc acquisition?
Can reference-detector and DUT spectral responsivity/EQE data be returned on declared wavelength grids with calibration provenance and no hidden interpolation?
Can detector/source linearity be characterized over the complete acquisition range used for R2?
Can the raw linearity data, configuration identifiers, correction policy, and uncertainty/provenance be returned?
Can repeated reference-detector sweeps be acquired with explicit day/session/sweep/intensity hierarchy and frozen configuration?
Can a prospective training/freeze/holdout split be honored such that holdout sessions are not used for model or QC tuning?
Can at least six repeated characterized electrical reference-step transients be injected through the exact intended SMU/digitizer/cabling/software path?
Can range/filter/aperture be fixed, autorange disabled, timestamps retained, and reference-step/timestamp uncertainty documented?
Can repeated 0.05 <-> 2 sun optical intensity-step transients be acquired on the same qualified R2 pixel under the intended measurement configuration?
Can the observation window extend beyond the intended dwell and retain all late-time samples needed to test unresolved slow tails?
Can the frozen 17-point 0.05-2 sun Voc-intensity grid be measured in both standard monotonic and supplied randomized-order schedules on the same qualified pixel?
Can actual elapsed time, target intensity, Voc, temperature/configuration identifiers, QC state, and acquisition order be returned for every observation?

decision_semantics.CONFIRMED: All required global questions and all questions for the capability are YES, with required evidence commitments identified.
decision_semantics.CONDITIONAL: At least one required item is CONDITIONAL and no required item is NO or UNKNOWN; all conditions are explicit and testable before execution.
decision_semantics.UNAVAILABLE: At least one required item is NO.
decision_semantics.NEEDS_CONFIRMATION: At least one required item is UNKNOWN or unanswered and no required item is NO.

anti_bias_rule: Use the identical questionnaire for every candidate. Do not remove, soften, reorder, or reinterpret a requirement because a preferred candidate cannot meet it. Any later contract revision must be versioned and applied prospectively to all candidates.
